nodes.text: @AshwiniVaishnawPlease issue an immediate warning to all national and regional news channels regarding the telecast of unverified news about the HMPV virus. The exaggerated reporting by some news channels is likely to create panic among the citizens of India

nodes.author: iamchandra17818
nodes.text: More than the virus itself, fear creates significant chaos. This can lead to an artificial increase in the demand for and prices of medicines and medical facilities. Please issue a warning that only news released by the Government of India regarding the virus should be telecast.
